nphi.summary: Africa CDC programme, financed by the World Bank Africa CDC Support Program (P178633), to establish and strengthen NPHIs in North Africa, including support for peer-to-peer learning and twinning between NPHIs in the region.

nphi.title: RKI–Africa CDC side events at CPHIA 2023 (Lusaka)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO AFRO and EMRO
nphi.summary: Two side events at the 2023 International Conference on Public Health in Africa presented joint epidemic-intelligence work under HSPA and launched an Africa CDC continental guidance framework for NCD, injury and mental-health surveillance…

nphi.title: Health-security partnership to strengthen disease surveillance and epidemic intelligence in Africa
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded project (2023–2024), delivered through ASLM, that supported WHO and Africa CDC on country partnerships, a regional bio-surveillance framework for high-risk pathogens, and early-warning and epidemic-intelligence training.

nphi.title: Peer-to-peer exchange NIPH – EPHI
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
nphi.summary: An NIPH delegation met staff and leadership of the Ethiopian Public Health Institute in a peer-to-peer collaboration.

nphi.title: China CDC – EPHI memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
nphi.summary: MoU signed by video link in August 2022 covering infectious disease prevention and control, maternal and child nutrition, and laboratory testing capacity, with interest in China's malaria-elimination experience.

nphi.title: NIPH–Africa CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC)
nphi.summary: Three-year MoU signed in June 2022 framing institutional collaboration under NIPH's BIS programme on health economics, preparedness, NCDs, surveillance and NPHI strengthening, with an NIPH staff member seconded to Addis Ababa.

nphi.title: ADPHC – Africa CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Africa CDC
nphi.summary: MoU signed in November 2022 to advance research and knowledge exchange, information sharing, joint capacity building and response mechanisms for public health challenges.

nphi.title: NaLaA – NLP for event-based surveillance with Africa CDC
nphi.with: Africa CDC; ProMED / ISID (USA); HISP (South Africa)
nphi.summary: Developed open-source AI tool to filter news/social media signals for Africa CDC event-based surveillance.

nphi.title: EU for health security in Africa: ECDC for Africa CDC
nphi.with: Africa CDC
nphi.summary: EU-funded (EUR 9 million to ECDC plus EUR 1 million to Africa CDC) four-year capacity project in which ECDC supports Africa CDC on preparedness and emergency operations, harmonised surveillance and epidemic intelligence, and public health…

nphi.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
nphi.with: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
nphi.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.

nphi.title: ENTRANT – East and Southern African Consortium for Outbreak Epidemiology Training
nphi.actor: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); National Health Laboratory Botswana; University of Nairobi; ZAMBART; Haramaya University; Mwanza Intervention Trials Unit; Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC-funded consortium offering master's-level outbreak epidemiology training in East and Southern Africa, with UVRI among the African partners.

nphi.title: Strengthening Crisis and Pandemic Response in Africa (BMZ/GIZ with Africa CDC)
nphi.with: GIZ; German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)
nphi.summary: Four-year project building Africa CDC's institutional capacity, support to NPHIs and the Africa Epidemic Service, local manufacturing and digital health.

nphi.title: KOICA – Africa CDC African Union COVID-19 emergency support project
nphi.with: Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA)
nphi.summary: KOICA and Africa CDC agreed a continent-wide project supplying treatment and diagnostic equipment and infection-prevention training, implemented with UNOPS.

nphi.title: Africa Pathogen Genomics Initiative (Africa PGI)
nphi.with: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation; US CDC; Microsoft; Illumina; Oxford Nanopore Technologies
nphi.summary: USD 100 million, four-year public-private partnership launched in October 2020 to build a continental network of sequencing laboratories, bioinformatics, data systems and trained staff for genomic surveillance.

nphi.title: ICMR – African Union MoU
nphi.with: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission
nphi.summary: MoU of 2019 on South–South health research collaboration, capacity building and development of drugs, diagnostics and vaccines for regional priority diseases.

nphi.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs
nphi.actor: Africa CDC Southern Africa Regional Collaborating Centre with ZNPHI
nphi.with: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: Three-day September 2019 meeting in Livingstone where Southern African NPHIs held peer exchanges on core functions, lessons and strategies, and agreed that exchange visits and peer mentorship are critical to NPHI development.

nphi.title: Africa CDC Institute for Workforce Development (with Emory University)
nphi.with: Emory University Rollins School of Public Health
nphi.summary: Africa CDC established its Institute for Workforce Development in 2019 in partnership with Emory's Rollins School of Public Health, offering courses on surveillance, AMR, proposal writing and leadership for African NPHIs and ministries.

nphi.title: ICMR/AU-STRC Health Practitioners and Researchers Capacity Building Scheme
nphi.with: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission (AU-STRC); ICMR-National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research (NICPR), Noida
nphi.summary: Under the ICMR–African Union MoU, ICMR set up a capacity-building scheme for African health researchers. Its first course, on molecular biology techniques for cancer research, trained 11 researchers from nine African countries at…

nphi.title: EPHI – GIMI memorandum of agreement on health management training
nphi.with: Galilee International Management Institute (GIMI)
nphi.summary: Agreement of 12 Jan 2018 giving EPHI staff yearly GIMI scholarships over five years in health and public administration.

nphi.title: Africa CDC – JICA letter of intent on health security
nphi.with: Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
nphi.summary: Letter of intent signed in Tokyo on 15 Dec 2017 covering laboratory networks, field epidemiology, early warning, IHR core capacities and joint research.

nphi.title: DQA and DQA PLUS – Quality assurance training for African drug quality control labs
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: WHO Regulation and Safety (Switzerland); InphA (Germany); national regulatory authorities and drug quality control labs of partner countries
nphi.summary: Trained national drug QC lab staff in ISO 17025 quality management to detect substandard anti-infectives.

nphi.title: US–African Union memorandum of cooperation to establish Africa CDC
nphi.with: African Union Commission / Africa CDC
nphi.summary: 2015 memorandum under which US CDC provided technical expertise and planning support to create Africa CDC, including two long-term US CDC advisors seconded to the AU and fellowships for 10 African epidemiologists.

nphi.title: ACILT laboratory training and the Labs for Life partnership
nphi.actor: National Health Laboratory Service (NHLS) – African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training (ACILT)
nphi.with: CDC South Africa; PEPFAR; Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD)
nphi.summary: NHLS's African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training, supported by CDC, provides hands-on training and mentoring to laboratory staff from partner countries, including under the PEPFAR/CDC–BD Labs for Life public-private partnership…

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: HSE–Ethiopia partnership on quality improvement and staff resilience
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.with: Ethiopian Ministry of Health; Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
nphi.summary: Ireland's HSE worked with Ethiopia's Ministry of Health and EPHI on quality-improvement training (completed 2020), staff mental-health and resilience workshops, and planned support for hospital accreditation.

nphi.title: LINDA-FAMILIA – scaling up digital health systems
nphi.with: University College Cork (coordinator)
nphi.summary: EDCTP3 project in which NIPH leads implementation science and trials of digital registries for maternal and child health in four African countries.
